Thanks for contributing an API to pay-skills. We're excited to have you onboard.

Once your PR is merged, your API will be published to the catalog and available from the `pay` CLI and `https://pay.sh/api/<fqn>` within minutes. If you want help with co-marketing, add a social handle below.

## API details

- Provider FQN:
- Service URL:
- Pull request:
- Social handle for co-marketing (optional):

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/solana-foundation/pay-skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and confirmed CI should pass.
- [ ] I ran the local validation command from the contributing guide, for example `pay catalog check providers/<operator>/<name>/PAY.md`.
- [ ] `PAY.md` accurately describes the API, including capabilities, endpoint usage, spend-aware best practices, and any required call sequence.
- [ ] The committed API spec or endpoint definitions match the live service.
- [ ] Commits are verified or signed.
- [ ] Bonus: I starred this repository.
